technical_completion.meaning: The repository has a production orchestrator, explicit coverage manifest, source-specific collectors, exact-only reconciliation, rebuildable SQLite model, CI workflows, documentation and validation gates. External source failure never becomes an inferred zero or a false completeness claim.

prefeitura_finance_2026_to_2026_08_17.note: Revenue and expense-stage aggregates are source-linked. Creditor totals are aggregates and are not individual payments.

prefeitura_detailed_contract_grid.source_call_verified: POST /contratos/gridDetalhada?pagina=N with the frontend filter object as JSON body
prefeitura_detailed_contract_grid.observed_limitation: detailed-grid probes timed out; GET /FiscaisContratos/downloadcsv returned HTTP 405
prefeitura_detailed_contract_grid.production_behavior: adaptive date-window collector preserves successful responses and marks failed windows partial; it never infers zero contracts from timeout

pncp_contracts.coverage_rule: complete_for_filter only when every query for the explicitly supplied/discovered agency CNPJs reaches a normal PNCP source end and the upstream procurement discovery for the same scope is complete

cms_commitments.pagination: persistent ScriptCase session, POST F3, nmgp_opcao=avanca
cms_commitments.current_completion_rule: source exhaustion AND parsed identifiers equal every visible commitment identifier on every page
cms_commitments.old_snapshot: explicitly superseded; old normalized commitments file removed; raw source snapshots retained

cms_identity_matching.rule: exact normalized official name or documented official alias only; name similarity alone never creates a political identity link
cms_identity_matching.privacy: individual CPF is masked in normalized output; CNPJ is retained

reconciliation.rule: exact normalized identifiers only; ambiguous hits remain multiple_candidates; no fuzzy object/vendor matching is promoted to fact
